method.description: Baseline rounds, all six ordered assignments per deal and format. Current planner is compared on the exact recorded final empty-pool pass positions; round trajectories and winners are not replayed with the new strategy. Witness search is constructive and bounded to racks of at most eight; no global no-move proof.

limitations: Seat-swapped rounds share deals and are correlated.
Unseen audit deals are separate from the hand-constructed regression fixtures; no heuristic was tuned to wins.
Witness patterns cover pair additions, one-tile transfers and duplicate-run splits, not every legal move.
No witness does not establish that a position is impossible to play.
Node/Linux timing is not physical Apple performance, battery life or human enjoyment.
